impacts.architecture_impact: Defines the eleven proposed aggregate roots.
impacts.persistence_impact: Controls storage ownership and transaction boundaries.
impacts.security_impact: Limits privilege and consistency blast radius.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Changing roots is a breaking contract change.

impacts.architecture_impact: Keeps Policy as root for Governance Rule.
impacts.object_library_impact: Preserves Policy and Governance Rule semantics.
impacts.api_impact: Commands address Policy aggregate for rule changes.
impacts.evidence_impact: Binds rule evaluation evidence to Policy version.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Separation later requires migration and compatibility review.

impacts.architecture_impact: Keeps Evidence and Review in one assurance aggregate.
impacts.persistence_impact: Supports atomic review binding to exact evidence versions.
impacts.authority_impact: Review never becomes acceptance authority automatically.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Separation requires durable cross-aggregate evidence references.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses one Finding root with remediation workflow state.
impacts.object_library_impact: Finding remains the adopted root object.
impacts.persistence_impact: Closure and remediation revision are protected together.
impacts.api_impact: Remediation and closure commands bind the Finding revision.
impacts.authority_impact: Closure authority remains independent or Human for CRITICAL/HIGH.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Splitting later requires saga and closure compatibility rules.

impacts.architecture_impact: Keeps Human Approval under Governance Authority aggregate.
impacts.persistence_impact: Approval bindings are stored with authority context.
impacts.authority_impact: Centralizes Human authority without granting technical actors sovereignty.
impacts.security_impact: Reduces replay and stale approval risk.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Independent aggregate remains a future breaking option.

impacts.architecture_impact: Adopts at-least-once delivery with idempotent consumers.
impacts.api_impact: Consumers must deduplicate before command admission.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Consumers must remain compatible with replay.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses tombstone plus supersession; no destructive delete.
impacts.object_library_impact: Canonical identity and history are preserved.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Future purge requires separate Human retention authority.

impacts.architecture_impact: Enables temporal query for governance and evidence entities first.
impacts.persistence_impact: Requires effective/recorded time projections for scoped entities.
impacts.evidence_impact: Supports point-in-time evidence and approval reconstruction.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Expanding scope is additive with cost review.

impacts.object_library_impact: Object semantic version stays separate from concurrency token.
impacts.api_impact: Mutation commands require expected aggregate revision.
impacts.authority_impact: Prevents concurrent authority and closure conflicts.
impacts.evidence_impact: Approval and Finding evidence bind revisions.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Granularity changes affect all command consumers.

impacts.architecture_impact: Scopes idempotency to command/event identity within namespace.
impacts.persistence_impact: Requires namespace plus idempotency key uniqueness.
impacts.api_impact: Duplicate commands return the prior accepted outcome.
impacts.evidence_impact: Duplicate evidence remains linked to original outcome.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Scope changes require compatibility and retention review.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses risk classes while exact legal durations remain a later Human policy.
impacts.object_library_impact: Evidence semantics and assurance fields remain unchanged.
impacts.persistence_impact: No purge until a Human-adopted schedule applies.
impacts.api_impact: Interfaces expose retention class, not storage tier.
impacts.authority_impact: Retention does not alter approval authority.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Exact durations remain a separate policy decision.

impacts.architecture_impact: Telemetry is not Evidence until explicitly registered and bound.
impacts.object_library_impact: Separates Runtime Event/telemetry from Evidence authority.
impacts.persistence_impact: Telemetry storage may be operational; Evidence registration is append-oriented.
impacts.api_impact: Evidence registration is an explicit command.
impacts.authority_impact: Producer cannot self-accept telemetry as Evidence.
impacts.evidence_impact: Registration records producer, subject, hash, collection context.
impacts.security_impact: Prevents low-assurance telemetry from gaining evidentiary weight.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Direct evidence profiles require future Human review.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses type/risk expiry or mandatory review date for Authority Grants.
impacts.object_library_impact: Authority Grant stays a supporting logical entity.
impacts.persistence_impact: Persists validity, scope, revocation, and review metadata.
impacts.api_impact: Admission rejects expired or unreviewed grants.
impacts.authority_impact: Authority ceilings and Human Gate remain mandatory.
impacts.security_impact: Prevents stale delegation and silent permanence.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses strict logical Command/Query separation with shared implementation undecided.
impacts.persistence_impact: Read projections cannot mutate source state.
impacts.api_impact: Commands and Queries use separate contracts.
impacts.authority_impact: Queries cannot confer or exercise mutation authority.
impacts.security_impact: Prevents hidden mutation in read interfaces.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses explicit event versions and compatibility profiles.
impacts.object_library_impact: Runtime Event remains canonical and versioned.
impacts.persistence_impact: Stores event type/version and payload hash.
impacts.authority_impact: New versions cannot expand authority implicitly.
impacts.security_impact: Prevents silent consumer breakage and spoofed authority fields.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Breaking changes require RFC, review, Human approval.

impacts.architecture_impact: Uses exact cross-volume reference without authority copy.
impacts.api_impact: Interfaces resolve references under caller scope.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Controlled mirror would require explicit provenance policy.

impacts.persistence_impact: Persists dependency DAG references, not copied packages.
impacts.api_impact: Package commands validate cycles and hashes.
impacts.compatibility_impact: Development-only cycles require a future bounded profile.
